_about: The clip library clips.py composes from: one vessel doing its thing, staged on its path and framed so it reads (Garrett, cut 6). `stage` runs after the cell swap and the vessel swap, `camera` after the settle, `events` at seconds from the clip's start (any mv verb). `stills` names the probe stills a clip was composed from and `learned` what each attempt taught.

gyroid-run.what: The Manta flies through a lattice of nested-gyroid and gyroid flora, the limbs swaying as it passes (the spindle graphs, fixed 2026-10-28).
learned: probe 1 (2026-10-28): the flora were planted at the cell's own sites hundreds of units from the pilot; 5 s of flying toward them showed empty membrane. The pilot is now teleported 160 u before the nearest flora (SetPose) once the plants are in.

probe 2: `flora` resolved the nearest flora, a quasicrystal, and the mount on the hull showed membrane. The gyroid is now named (name:GyroidFlora), the camera orbits the plant slowly and the hull flies through it.
probe 3: the gyroid is in frame at last (the braided limbs render since the port) but an orbit at 55 u sat inside the plant's own prisms; 95 u shows the whole lattice with the Manta flying through.

probe 4: the 95 u orbit showed the plant (a braided arch over a floor of slab prisms) but the Manta was lost in it; the clip is the hull flying THROUGH the arch, so the camera rides the hull at back 24 from 140 u out.

final 1 (1080p): empty membrane again - the name matched one of the three gyroid SEEDLINGS planted two seconds earlier, not the Lattice cell's own grown colony the probe had found. No more planting: the cell's own gyroids, 200 u out, boost through.

serpent-wall.what: The Serpent stops in the turret stance beside a rival fleet's trails; its seed prism pulls the loose prisms into a self-assembling herringbone wall, stealing them as they land.
learned: probe 1: the stance worked (the Serpent stopped, the rival fleet circled it laying trails) but 5 s from the toggle showed no wall yet, and the hull drew as a solid white blob: the stance's cloak ghost (CosmicShore/CloakGhost, a hand-written additive shader) had no translation in the engine. The stance now happens 7.5 s before the recording so the wall is growing on frame one.
probe 2: the stance 7.5 s before the recording gave a dense violet prism field round the Serpent (the wall?); the hull was the untranslated cloak ghost, ported since. Orbit closer: 22.
probe 3: the cloak ghost renders (a translucent rimmed hull) and the herringbone wall stands around it; 28 u shows a little more of the wall.

dolphin-echo.what: The Dolphin, right trigger held, lights every prism in its echo cone, flies into a crystal and the crystal blast obliterates the mass ahead.
learned: probe 1: the Dolphin was a speck at back 40 and the rival trails were far off its path; nothing of the cone or the blast read. The fleet now circles the pilot (trails wrap its path), the mount sits at back 24, the crystal is placed 100 u ahead at the first frame.
probe 2: at back 24 the Dolphin was still a speck - the hull is a few units long; back 14.
probe 3: the echo cone reads - cyan beams fanning from the hull over the mass ahead; the hull is visible at back 14.
probe 4: setup and payoff read - the Dolphin runs at the ringed omni crystal and the blast bursts the mass beyond it in purple shards.

thresher-slice.what: The Thresher whips its wrecking ball round on a rigid chain through a rival fleet's trails: the chain slices every rival prism it crosses, the ball at smash speed bursts them.

events.why: mass mode off: the ball breaks

learned: probe 1: the ball went red and the chain whipped - the clip's subject works - but the hull was small and the rival trails were elsewhere. The fleet now circles the Thresher so the chain crosses their trails; the mount is a tighter three-quarter view.
probe 2: the fleet's trails now wrap the Thresher (a pink wall in the last frames, the ball red through it) but the hull was tiny at back 26; back 16.
probe 3: at back 16 the hull filled the frame and the ball on its 25 u chain was out of it; a 40 u orbit holds hull, chain and ball with the trails around.
probe 4: the 40 u orbit keeps hull, chain and the red ball in frame; the slicing of the rivals' trails is still not evident in the stills.

sparrow-guns.what: The Sparrow, right trigger held, pours its gun into a rival fleet's trails ahead; the rounds (the glowing spheres Garrett liked in cut 3) burst the prisms they hit.
learned: probe 5: the Sparrow reads; its rounds' sparks use CosmicShore/SoftSpark, untranslated in the engine (drawn unlit), so the gun's look waits on that port.

rhino-sword.what: The Rhino drives through a rival fleet's trails swinging its energy sword: every prism the blade sweeps is CUT along the plane, the halves parting and dissolving from the cut face.
learned: probe 5: the Rhino is a big hull - at back 20 it filled the frame and hid the blade; back 46.

brittlestar-ring.what: The Brittle Star in Space mode fires its five turret guns into the mass around it, then throws its ring: a flat disk explosion as wide as the nucleus that clears every prism in its plane.

events.why: the ring thrown and detonated (a spare ring comes from the crystal)

learned: probe 5: the ring (a pentagon) and the trails read but no disk explosion came: a throw needs a SPARE ring, one per crystal collected, so a crystal is now placed on the path first.
